title: This AI Can Fact-Check Claims for You
description:
Lens provides audit-grade accuracy by using five models to debate and score claims.

This system gives you visible reasoning and sources for every verdict, moving beyond simple black-box answers. It connects to your existing automated workflows through a flexible API, making it easy to plug into n8n or Zapier for real-time verification.

Comment "FACT" if you want the API documentation link. Subscribe for more AI reasoning tool breakdowns.
